item.title: Gaels Fall 3-1 to Brock Badgers in Competitive OUA Semifinal
item.description: The Queen's Gaels Women's Volleyball team fought hard in the OUA semifinal but fell to the Brock Badgers in four sets, with final scores of 21-25, 21-25, 25-21, and 22-25. The Gaels showcased determined defence, strong offensive execution, and resilience throughout the match, but were ultimately unable to advance to the final.

item.title: Queen's Men's Basketball's Jakub Dobiech named OUA Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year
item.description: Queen's Men's Basketball's Jakub Dobiech has been named the OUA Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year for the 2025-26 season, the conference announced on Friday.

item.title: GAELS SWEEP LAKERS TO PUNCH THEIR TICKET TO OUA FINALS
item.description: The Queen's Gaels swept the Nipissing Lakers 3-0 in the OUA semifinals on Friday night at home to punch themselves a ticket to the OUA finals. Leading the charge on offense for the Gaels was Nikola Mitrovic (Economics) with a staggering 16 kills, while middle Alex Brdarevic (Engineering) put up a solid 7 kills. Outside hitter Reed Venning (Arts & Science) made 6 kills and 4 service aces, while Chris Zimmerman (Arts) directed the offense with 34 assists and 1 kill.

item.title: Queen's Women's Hockey even Round 2 series with Ontario Tech with big road win
item.description: Queen's Women's Hockey evened their Round 2 series with the Ontario Tech Ridgebacks with a 3-1 win in Oshawa, Ont. Friday night.

item.title: Gaels Stun No. 2 Seed Concordia Stingers 2–1 to Advance to Queen’s Cup Semifinals.
item.description: After taking Game One on the road in Montreal against the Concordia Stingers, the Queen's Gaels men's ice hockey returned to home ice for Game Two of the OUA Queen's Cup Quarterfinals with a chance to close out the best-of-three series and punch their ticket to the semifinals in pursuit of gold.

item.title: 2026 season ticket packages for defending Yates Cup champion Queen’s Football on sale NOW
item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Queen's Gaels mourn the passing of Football Champion and Coach Bob Howes
item.description: Queen's Athletics & Recreation is saddened to learn of the passing of Bob Howes, a distinguished Queen's alumnus, championship coach, and one of the most accomplished football student-athletes ever to wear the Tricolour.

item.title: Gaels Fall 2–1 to Ridgebacks in Game Three Quarterfinal Heartbreaker.
item.description: Queen's Gaels Women's Hockey returned to home ice for a decisive Game Three against the Ontario Tech Ridgebacks, with a spot in the Ontario University Athletics semifinals on the line. With the best-of-three quarterfinal series tied, the Gaels looked to harness the energy of their home crowd and carry momentum into the final matchup in what shaped up to be a tightly contested playoff battle.

item.title: Nikola Mitrovic, Kennedy Millin named Queen's Student-Athletes of the Week
item.description: Nikola Mitrovic and Kennedy Millin have been named the Queen's Gaels Varsity Student-Athletes of the Week for their performances this past weekend.

item.title: Queen's Distance Track bringing small but competitive team to U SPORTS Track & Field Championship
item.description: Queen's Distance Track will send a small, but very competitive team into this year's U SPORTS Track & Field Championships in Winnipeg, Man. this week. The Gaels will send Elizabeth Vroom, Jude Wheeler-Dee, and Tanner Hueglin to the national championship, with all three competitors having a legitimate chance to medal in their respective events in what is expected to be some of the greatest races ever run at the U SPORTS level.
